content: The most vital need of the modern soul is for a sense of meaning.
author: Carl Jung
sourceWork: The Archetypes and the Collective Unconscious
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. True wisdom is rarely complicated or flashy, but it demands the honesty to look at our own habits and assumptions without defensive excuses.

In Carl Jung's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. When you stop looking for external validation and anchor your self-worth in quiet integrity, the noisy chaos of the world loses its power over you. A good life is built day by day through small, conscious choices.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
